answers: The user interface designer presented a good-looking design with few buttons. As for the colour, the user interface designer suggested making a backlight of the LCD screen with different colours, but this was denied due to the high cost. Then the industrial designer recommended changing the colour of the assembly at an extra charge to meet special needs. Light and infrared were also taken into consideration to make the controller glow in the dark. In order to make a smart controller, the group mentioned speech recognition and user identification.

full.prediction: The discussion about the user interface concept centered on deciding between push buttons and an LCD display. The team ultimately decided to use push buttons due to cost and simplicity considerations, while also incorporating speech recognition technology. They also considered the possibility of an LCD display for information output but found it more expensive and less feasible within their budget. The interface was designed to be simple, with a focus on usability and a minimal number of buttons. Additionally, there was a suggestion to include a backlight with different colors for enhanced visibility and aesthetic appeal.
